status: Shared owner-approved overlapping categories for Publications and Selected Working Papers, aligned on 2026-10-23. Each list retains its original order.

topics.label: Mortality, Health & Longevity
topics.scope: Mortality forecasting, longevity risk, epidemics, environmental health and life expectancy.

topics.label: Climate Risk, Agriculture & Sustainability
topics.scope: Climate and environmental impacts, agriculture, catastrophe risk, adaptation, crop and forage insurance, yield forecasting, agricultural reinsurance and basis risk.

topics.label: AI & Machine Learning in Insurance and Finance
topics.scope: Substantive neural-network, deep-learning, boosting and kernel-learning applications. Conventional statistical modelling and passing mentions of AI do not qualify.

topics.label: Financial Markets, Hedging & Risk Transfer
topics.scope: Insurance-linked securities, hedging, financial inclusion, financial dependence, risk-transfer contracts, and insurance loss modelling or pricing that underpins risk transfer.
